title: 사진관에서 증명사진 찍기: 턱 당기고, 그대로 계세요
objective: Say what ID photo you need and give a reason with -거든요.
summary: Order an ID photo and follow posing directions.
setting: A small photo studio (사진관) in a Korean neighborhood. A customer comes in to take a passport photo before a business trip.

task.title: Use the studio expressions
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to fill in, choose, order, or answer in Korean.

words.meaning: ID photo (for résumés, passports, ID cards)
words.exampleMeaning: I need an ID photo to put on my résumé.

words.example: 라면을 먹고 자서 아침에 얼굴이 부었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I ate ramyeon before bed, so my face was puffy in the morning.

words.example: 턱을 너무 많이 당기면 목이 짧아 보여요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you pull your chin in too much, your neck looks short.

words.example: 허리를 펴고 앉으면 더 키가 커 보여요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you sit with your back straight, you look taller.

words.meaning: just as it is, without moving
words.exampleMeaning: Keep smiling just like that and look at the camera.

dialogue.korean: 어서 오세요. 무슨 사진 찍으실 거예요?
dialogue.meaning: Welcome. What kind of photo are you going to take?

dialogue.korean: 여권 사진이요. 다음 달에 해외 출장이 있거든요.
dialogue.meaning: A passport photo. I have a business trip abroad next month, you see.

dialogue.korean: 네, 그럼 먼저 거울 보고 머리 좀 정리하세요. 보정도 해 드릴까요?
dialogue.meaning: Okay, then please look in the mirror and tidy your hair first. Would you like retouching too?

dialogue.korean: 네, 조금만 해 주세요. 요즘 잠을 못 자서 얼굴이 좀 부었거든요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, just a little, please. I haven't been sleeping well lately, so my face is a bit puffy.

dialogue.korean: 알겠습니다. 자, 여기 의자에 앉으세요. 턱을 살짝 당기고 어깨를 펴 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Got it. Okay, please sit in this chair. Pull your chin in slightly and straighten your shoulders.

dialogue.korean: 고개가 왼쪽으로 조금 기울었어요. 오른쪽으로 살짝만 기울여 주세요. 네, 좋아요. 그대로 계세요. 찍겠습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Your head is tilted a little to the left. Please tilt it slightly to the right. Yes, good. Stay just like that. I'm taking it now.

dialogue.korean: 사진은 언제 찾을 수 있어요? 오늘 오후에 구청에 가야 하거든요.
dialogue.meaning: When can I pick up the photos? I have to go to the district office this afternoon, you see.

exercises: Fill in the blanks with -거든요 (use the word in brackets): ① A: 왜 사진을 다시 찍어요? B: 아까 눈을 ____. (감다) ② A: 증명사진은 왜 찍어요? B: 이력서에 사진을 ____. (붙여야 하다)
Choose the right word: ① 사진사: 어깨를 쭉 (펴 / 당겨) 주세요. ② 사진사: 턱은 조금만 (펴 / 당겨) 주세요.
Choose the best action: The photographer says, "좋아요, 그대로 계세요." What should you do? (A) 다른 의자로 가요 (B) 움직이지 않아요 (C) 머리를 다시 정리해요
Answer in Korean: The staff asks "보정해 드릴까요?" Ask for just a little retouching, and give the reason "my eyes are a bit puffy" with -거든요.
answers: 네, 조금만 해 주세요. 눈이 좀 부었거든요. (조금만 보정해 주세요 / 눈이 조금 부었거든요 are also fine.)
